subject.title: fix(diagnostic): memory env thresholds for foreign key/size key errors on first-run

question: Should OpenClaw support eight new diagnostic memory environment variables when this PR has not connected them to the reported first-run storage failure?
rationale: The branch creates a new configuration surface rather than demonstrating a repair to the reported behavior, so maintainers must decide whether the controls are a desired product contract at all.

options.title: Repair the reported storage failure
options.body: Replace this unrelated threshold configuration with a focused repair at the proven first-run storage initialization path.

options.title: Sponsor diagnostics configuration separately
options.body: Treat the environment overrides as a separately scoped diagnostics feature with explicit documentation, validation, and compatibility ownership.

recommendation.title: Repair the reported storage failure
recommendation.body: Replace this unrelated threshold configuration with a focused repair at the proven first-run storage initialization path.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the only identified person connected to the submitted change; repository ownership requires a feature-history pass before routing to a current-main owner.
